description: This file defines the UploadState class used for tracking and managing the state of multipart uploads in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes constants for upload statuses, properties to store upload details (ID, part size, uploaded parts, status), and methods to manipulate and query this state.

classes.name: UploadState
classes.description: Represents the state of a multipart upload, tracking uploaded parts and status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new UploadState with the given upload ID parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the upload, typically a set of parameters.

methods.name: setUploadId
methods.description: Sets a component of the upload ID, often after initiating an upload.

methods.name: getPartSize
methods.description: Returns the size allocated for each upload part.

methods.name: setPartSize
methods.description: Defines the size of each part for upload.

methods.name: markPartAsUploaded
methods.description: Marks a specific part number as uploaded, storing associated data.

methods.name: hasPartBeenUploaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific part has already been uploaded.

methods.name: getUploadedParts
methods.description: Retrieves all uploaded parts in sorted order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the current status of the upload (Created, Initiated, Completed).

methods.name: isInitiated
methods.description: Checks if upload is in the initiated state.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if upload has been completed.
